registered_protocol.scope: Strict pass interceptions only; v9 retained unchanged unless promotion gate passes. No global movement, shot, goalkeeper or tactical changes.
registered_protocol.development: 128 paired fixtures: 8 styles x4 unused seeds x4 side/kickoff arrangements. Candidate may be corrected using development only.
registered_protocol.fresh: 560 paired fixtures: 14 known frozen styles x10 disjoint unused seeds x4 arrangements. Freeze source before results; never tune on fresh scores.
registered_protocol.promotion: More fresh points AND paired whole-seed bootstrap 95% lower bound >0. No policy exceptions, no reproducible timing failures. Mean decision time <=champion*1.25+0.03ms, no more than 2 additional raw candidate timeouts per1000fixtures. Otherwise retain v9 as champion.
registered_protocol.timing: Native 20ms deadline. Preserve raw rows; exact timeout-containing fixtures may be repeated max3, first clean regardless of score; preserve every attempt. Exception fails the run.
registered_protocol.note: Local points over known frozen opponents are not actual league points or league rank evidence.

initial_development_freeze.selection: Use the corrected physical-ordering candidate; prototypes only inform runtime engineering and regressions. No fresh scores seen or used.

runtime_equivalence.purpose: Development-only runtime optimization regression; not fresh strength evidence.

initial_development_freeze.ordering_correction: Current range alone is not a legal future kick: a post-movement pre-step-ball witness is required. Added before fresh evaluation.

Mean decision time <=champion*1.25+0.03ms, no more than 2 additional raw candidate timeouts per1000fixtures. Otherwise retain v9 as champion.
